script.title: Does Drinking Water During Meals Ruin Digestion?
script.description: Does drinking water while eating dilute your stomach acid and ruin digestion? Let us look at what the science actually says about how your stomach works.

scenes.narration: Does drinking water during meals ruin your digestion, and what actually happens inside?
The idea that water washes away stomach acid is a complete myth.
Your stomach produces about one point five liters of acidic gastric juice daily.
This fluid has a very strong pH between one and three to break down food.
It actively regulates production using feedback systems to increase acid when needed after a meal.
This means drinking water does not stop your stomach from doing its chemical job.
This is general information, not medical advice. Does drinking water help you eat slower?
